info.title: Job Application Tracker API
info.description: A production-grade REST API for managing job applications, interview scheduling, user profiles, authentication, and application analytics.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Access Token in standard Bearer format

notes.example: Review system architecture and distributed locking.

get.description: Verify operational health and uptime status of the API server.

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returning access and refresh tokens.
Exchange an existing refresh token for a newly rotated token pair.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or revoked refresh token

400.description: Validation error or protected field modification

200.description: Password changed successfully and active sessions revoked

400.description: Validation error or same password supplied
Invalid state transition or validation failure

delete.description: Hard deletes an application and atomically cascade-deletes all associated interviews.

200.description: Application and child interviews deleted permanently

409.description: Scheduling conflict with another active interview

get.description: Queries active interviews scheduled within the next N days (default 7).

400.description: Invalid state transition or validation failure

get.description: Calculates high-level job application statistics and conversion rates for non-archived data.
Breakdown of non-archived applications grouped by status, priority, job type, and workplace type.
Calculates application-to-interview, interview-to-offer, and offer conversion funnel rates with zero-division safety.
Returns chronological UTC monthly application counts with missing months zero-filled.
